artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: ROUND 3 / CRPS-e-1: `--evidence <path>` (dry-run and fire alike) loads and shape-checks (`load_evidence_table`) a curated evidence table ("rows" list, each {folder, root, cc, action, tier, basis, ...}) BEFORE any row is classified -- a malformed table (no list under "rows", a row missing folder/root/cc/action, or an action outside {register, associate}) is REFUSED, rc 2, printed (test_main_refuses_malformed_evidence_table_before_classifying_rows: rows_for_run monkeypatched to raise if reached, proving the refusal happens first). `effective_row(row, evidence_table)` (new; `effective_state_and_reason` kept as a back-compat 2-tuple wrapper over its first two fields) is consulted per row: a table hit (by folder) overrides state to EVIDENCED unconditionally (over NO_EVIDENCE, AMBIGUOUS, DISAGREEMENT and even amendment 1's own folder-vs-report check), root/cc come from the table row, reason is cited 'evidence table <tier>: <basis>', evidence_source 'evidence-table', association_expected True iff the table row's action is 'associate'; a folder the table does not name keeps the report-text path (evidence_source 'report-text', association_expected always False). run() places EVERY table-named row in the batch request (a table row's own root/cc, regardless of its raw classifier state), and an 'associate' row's request carries association_expected: true. Every result row's read-back now carries the classifier's RAW `state` (row['state'], unchanged) beside the computed `effective_state` and `evidence_source`; the printed 'skip ...' line uses effective_state (unchanged user-facing behaviour for the DISAGREEMENT case). run() and write_readback() both take an optional `deliverables_dir` (default DELIVERABLES_DIR); every test now passes tmp_path so no test writes into the real deliverables dir. build_parser()/main() gained `--evidence`, wired to both --dry-run and --fire. Measured on the real 93-folder library via --dry-run --as-of 2026-09-24 --evidence UNRESOLVED40_CALLS_20260924.json (run twice, byte-identical): population 41 evidenced 40 ambiguous 0 disagreement 0 other 1 called 40 registered 38 already_registered 1 refused 1 errors 0 bloomberg_calls 0 batch_calls 1 pool_puts 0 sum 41 -- the 5 association_expected rows (Bunzl, Copa, QXO, Uber, UMG) all read raw state NO_EVIDENCE/AMBIGUOUS, effective_state EVIDENCED, evidence_source evidence-table, outcome registered (verified directly against the written read-back JSON).

29 tests (20 pre-existing from CRPS-d-5/round 2, unchanged in behaviour except test_run_reclassifies_disagreement_and_never_calls_it and test_run_refuses_rootless_row_before_ever_batching_it, both updated to assert the new raw-state/effective_state/evidence_source triple instead of the old single 'state' field, and every run()-calling test now passes deliverables_dir=str(tmp_path)) + 9 NEW (section 7): load_evidence_table's shape checks (valid rows, non-list rows, missing keys, bad action) as ValueError with printable messages; effective_row's unconditional override over NO_EVIDENCE/AMBIGUOUS/a raw-EVIDENCED-but-disagreeing row, and the untouched report-text path; run()'s full evidence-table wiring (raw state preserved, effective_state EVIDENCED, evidence_source, association_expected true only for the 'associate' row, both table rows batched, the untouched third row skipped); run()'s deliverables_dir honoured over the (poisoned, must-never-be-created) module default; write_readback's deliverables_dir; and main()'s malformed-evidence-table refusal before rows_for_run is ever reached. Whole-file run (no -k): 29 passed in 0.76s (run twice, identical). Whole-package `python -m pytest lib/research/corpus -q -p no:cacheprovider`: 269 passed.

AC2's --dry-run --evidence read-back over the real 93-folder library: population 41, evidenced 40, called 40, batch.requests carries 40 {folder, bloomberg[, association_expected]} objects, and every row carries state/effective_state/evidence_source/association_expected (verified directly: 5 association_expected=true rows -- Bunzl BNZL GB, Copa CPA, QXO, Uber Technologies UBER US, Universal Music Group UMG NL -- all evidence_source evidence-table, raw state NO_EVIDENCE or AMBIGUOUS, outcome registered). Written only under this worker's own deliverables dir.
